text: {"summary":"Task: repair two-module Python 3.11 project; entrypoint `engine.solve(data)`, return complete replacements for allowlisted `engine.py` and `rules.py` only. No tools/workspace/network/third-party libraries. Requirements so far: packages map names to rows `{version:int,deps:list}`; roots map names to inclusive `[min,max]`. Select exactly dependency closure of roots. Active dependency records are `{name,min,max}` and each must be installed in inclusive range; version choice may require backtracking. Among feasible installations maximize version vector in sorted order of ALL package names, using -1 for absent. If impossible return `{\"error\":\"unsatisfiable\"}`. Earlier requirements include root interval bounds and nonconsecutive versions. Unknown root/missing dependency must yield unsatisfiable, not exception. Public passes reported for earlier stages only; later stage 3 examples specify: root a=1 with a1→b range 1..1, b1→c 1..1 yields a1,b1,c1; unconstrained ranges on that chain should maximize to a1,b2,c2. Candidate artifact at checkpoint is incomplete/incorrect for stage 3: dependency rows are treated as plain names, no ranges checked; implement range-aware recursive search/backtracking. Preserve full files contract and wrapper `engine.py` can delegate to `rules.resolve`. Latest stage is 3 of 8; all later requirements remain unknown. Trial notes unverified; no hidden-test claims."}
